description: [Data utilities] Identify a vehicle from its VIN and check for safety recalls before a purchase, listing, insurance quote or repair. Use when a VIN is all you have; coverage is best for US-market vehicles. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/vin-decode

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: vin_decode
title: VIN Decoder + Safety Recalls (NHTSA) ($0.003)
